subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source opt-out for the personal `.agents/skills` root, and should that be a typed source-disable list or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the fix adds public config surface in an area where repository policy sets a high bar for new knobs and requires consistent discovery, watcher, docs, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve typed source opt-out
options.body: Add a typed, backward-compatible setting for disabling named built-in skill sources and apply it before discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Approve narrow personal toggle
options.body: Add only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle to minimize config surface, accepting that project-agent source disabling would remain unsolved.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep the current built-in source behavior and document agent allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables as the supported mitigation.

recommendation.title: Approve typed source opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a typed, backward-compatible setting for disabling named built-in skill sources and apply it before discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills-runtime history and watcher ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the config and runtime-surface decision.
